how: We read the website of every Chicago wedding planner listed on Lazo (135 listings, 105 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiants and notaries, decor-only companies, a planner closing at the end of 2025, a national franchise's Chicago page, and a Northwest Indiana planner listed three times. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How many Chicago weddings have you run this year, and at which venues? The venue and vendor relationships are what you are paying for.
Who is on site on the day, you or an associate, and for how many hours?
If it is a winter or tented wedding, who owns the weather plan and the extra costs that come with it?

picks.name: Sweetchic Events, Inc.
picks.blurb: Sweetchic Events has planned Chicago weddings since 2008 for busy professionals who, in its words, already have a full-time job. Several levels of planning and coordination, and a values statement on the site that includes marrying whomever you love.

picks.name: One Fine Day Events
picks.blurb: Gina has 24 years in the industry and leans on those vendor relationships to negotiate on her couples' behalf. One Fine Day Events is based in Downers Grove and serves the city and the western suburbs with full planning and coordination.

picks.name: Citygirl Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Planning, design and floral under one roof: Citygirl Events has run its three teams as one collective since 2009, with more than 500 weddings behind it in Chicago, the North Shore and destinations. Tiers run from full service to a takeover six to eight weeks out, plus one-off planning sessions.

picks.name: Honey Bee Weddings
picks.blurb: Misse Daniel founded Honey Bee Weddings in April 2007 and specializes in sustainable luxury, with a board seat at the Green Wedding Alliance and experience in Indian, South Asian, Korean, Filipino and Nigerian weddings. She also teaches special events at Loyola University Chicago.

picks.name: Creatively Yours Wedding + Event Planning
picks.blurb: Tami Hacker is a Certified Wedding Consultant who started Creatively Yours in 2006 after her own wedding, and now marks 20 years of coordination. McHenry-based, covering the northwest suburbs and southern Wisconsin, with full planning and day-of options.

picks.name: FORUREVENTS LLC
picks.blurb: Aarti Kapoor founded ForUrEvents in 2016 to plan Indian and South Asian weddings in Chicago, from Roka and Mehndi through Sangeet, Baraat and the ceremony, across Punjabi, Gujarati, South Indian and fusion styles. Decor, catering and photo partners are offered under one roof.

picks.name: Urban Allure Events
picks.blurb: Nicole Fauls runs Urban Allure as a planning and design firm for bold, fully custom celebrations, including tent builds and multi-day timelines, and founded the West Loop and North Side Wedding Walks. Pricing is percentage-based and the site states no vendor kickbacks, ever.

picks.name: Lola Event Productions LLC
picks.blurb: The LOLA Pros have sent thousands of couples down the aisle since 2006, a team whose combined experience passes 100 years, now owned by Kristy and Michelle. Tiers range from full project management to a sounding-board package and a single jump-start session with a senior planner.

picks.name: HBIC Weddings
picks.blurb: HBIC Weddings prints its starting points, $2,495 for coordination and $5,995 for planning, and sells a kickstart session that becomes a credit if you add planning later. Elmhurst-based planners who promise to be in the thick of things on the day rather than on the sidelines.

picks.name: Frank Event Design
picks.blurb: Frank Andonoplas has planned Chicago weddings for more than 20 years and takes one event per weekend so his team stays on yours. Full-service planning and design, with etiquette guidance and officiant services among the extras.

picks.name: Cygnet Events and Design
picks.blurb: Cygnet Events and Design, founded in 2012, plans weddings and wedding weekends only, with full-service and partial options and a specialty in tented weddings. Chicago-based, working the East Coast and international destinations as well.

picks.name: Bridget Mary Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Bridget started the business in 2019 after five years in corporate events and now plans with Alicia across Chicago, New York City and South Florida. Packages run from 90-day coordination to full planning, and the aim is for you to be a guest at your own wedding.
